caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, textured relief with raised elements, featuring dark gray and lighter gray tones to represent the surface and depth of the engraving. At the top of the relief, there is a band of large, capitalized German text in a sans-serif style, arranged in two lines within a border. Below the text, in the central area of the relief, there are several stylized, geometric animal figures arranged in two rows; the upper row includes animals that resemble cows or oxen and the lower row has smaller quadruped figures, possibly sheep or goats. The animals are simplified, block-like, and have well-defined legs, heads, and bodies, with some overlapping. At the bottom of the relief, another set of capitalized German text is similarly engraved in two lines, also bordered and occupying the entire width of the relief. The stone or slab appears to be set against a plain off-white background, emphasizing the relief’s rectangular shape and contrasting its dark, textured surface with the lighter backdrop.
title: Pa. German Stove Plate
